label: How Krans weighs a claim
title: From vague, to they put something at stake.
captions:
Not every learning weighs the same.

Krans grades each one on an evidence scale, from E0 (vague) to E5 (they put something at stake), and cites who said it and when. Conviction stops being a feeling and becomes something you can audit.

krans.ai

E0 is vague. E5 means they put something at stake.

Every learning in Krans is graded on that scale and cited to who said it and when, so you can see which bets are backed and which are guesses.

krans.ai

A quote is not a signal until you know what it weighs.

Krans grades every learning from E0 to E5 and keeps the source attached, so a claim can always be checked.

label: Days
title: A claim nobody repeats loses its weight.
captions:
Evidence ages.

In Krans, a claim nobody has repeated for sixty days loses weight, along with the positions built on it. Confidence fades wherever nothing new confirms it, so the model is never out of date.

krans.ai

Sixty days.

That is how long a claim holds its weight in Krans before it starts to fade, unless something new confirms it. Old conviction does not get to pass as current.

krans.ai

Evidence has a shelf life.

In Krans, a claim nobody repeats for sixty days loses weight, and so do the positions built on it.
